meta_join_gridwater.observation: Three separate detection paths (grid outage footprint, water alarm suppression, and VPN session attribution) all converge on the same credential (GW-ENG-VELA) and the same jump host (GW-SYS-JMP-01). The jump-host session source IPs link to KESTREL, which is the same adversary cluster documented in Rafael threads T6 and T7. This means the utility cyberattack was not an opportunistic exploitation of hurricane chaos — it was a pre-planned component of STATE-X's multi-vector campaign against the Texas Coastal Bend, designed to compound civilian harm, disrupt port recovery operations, and confuse attribution.
